component.name: NoirXD
component.summary: Remove MIUI and HyperOS bloatware over ADB, without root

description.p: NoirXD removes bloatware, ads and telemetry from Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones running MIUI or HyperOS 1, 2 and 3. It works over ADB and needs no root and no bootloader unlock.

ul.li: 640+ MIUI and HyperOS packages with plain-English descriptions and a risk rating
The package list updates from the project repository without reinstalling the app
Reversible: apps are uninstalled for the current user only and can be restored

description.p: NoirXD is a fork of the original Xiaomi Debloater project by Fadel Trivandi Dipantara, rebranded with a Spanish interface and the Flat Noir visual identity.
